description: This file contains utility functions and types for orchestrating Docker containers, setting up a host orchestrator service, loading Docker images, and managing CVD creation for Android testing infrastructure. It includes functions for starting/stopping containers, loading images, executing commands inside containers, and handling bug reports and logs.

classes.name: TestContext
classes.description: Holds information about the Docker container and service URL for testing setup.

classes.name: DockerHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with Docker, such as loading images, starting/stopping containers, executing commands, and retrieving logs.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes Docker helper, loads the Docker image, runs the container, and waits until the host orchestrator service is up.

methods.name: waitUntilServiceIsUp
methods.description: Polls the service URL until it responds with HTTP 200 OK or times out.

methods.name: NewDockerHelper
methods.description: Creates a new DockerHelper instance with a Docker client.

methods.name: LoadImage
methods.description: Loads a Docker image from a tar archive specified relative to the working directory.

methods.name: RemoveImage
methods.description: Removes a Docker image by name.

methods.name: RunContainer
methods.description: Creates and starts a Docker container with specified image.

methods.name: getIpAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a container's bridge network.

methods.name: PullLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs from a container and writes them to a file.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a running container forcefully.

methods.name: RemoveHostTool
methods.description: Removes a file inside a container by executing 'rm' command.

methods.name: StartADBServer
methods.description: Starts the ADB server inside a container.

methods.name: ConnectADB
methods.description: Connects to an ADB device inside a container.

methods.name: ExecADBShellCommand
methods.description: Executes a shell command inside a container targeting a specific ADB serial.

methods.name: runExec
methods.description: Helper that runs a command inside a container, waits for its completion, and returns the output.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up Docker containers and images after tests run.

methods.name: DownloadHostBugReport
methods.description: Requests a bug report ZIP file from the host orchestrator service and verifies its integrity.

methods.name: UploadAndExtract
methods.description: Uploads a file to the host orchestrator service, extracts it, and waits for completion.

methods.name: verifyZipFile
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a ZIP file by attempting to read all contained files.

methods.name: VerifyLogsEndpoint
methods.description: Checks HTTP endpoints for logs to ensure they are accessible.

methods.name: CreateCVDFromUserArtifactsDir
methods.description: Creates a CVD (Android Virtual Device) environment configuration based on a user artifacts directory.
